<!-- Your hub page -->
<!-- Generated by build/build.py. Paste the whole thing into one Brightspace HTML topic.
     Safe to edit the SUBMIT line: the next build reads it back and keeps it. -->
<iframe id="lab"
        src="https://corydave.github.io/websitetest/mc/csc-145/03-publish/04-hub-page.html"
        title="Your hub page"
        style="width:100%; border:0; height:85vh; height:85dvh;"></iframe>
<script>
  // Two things, set per topic:
  var SITE   = 'https://corydave.github.io';          // where the handouts are hosted (origin only)
  var SUBMIT = '';   // this lab's hand-in link (a Brightspace assignment URL).

  var lab = document.getElementById('lab');
  var desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px) and (hover: hover)');

  // Desktop: the handout reports its height (lab.js) and the frame grows to fit,
  // so the Brightspace page scrolls as one. Phones: the frame stays screen-height
  // and the handout scrolls inside it - a tall frame flashes white on phones.
  window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    if (e.origin !== SITE) return;                     // only our site
    if (!desktop.matches) return;
    if (e.data && typeof e.data.vibeHeight === 'number') {
      lab.style.height = (e.data.vibeHeight + 20) + 'px';
    }
  });

  // Hand the page its "submit your work" link. The link lives here, in the
  // course, not in the public repo. Sent only to our site's origin, so a copy
  // of this snippet elsewhere cannot push a link into our frame.
  lab.addEventListener('load', function () {
    lab.contentWindow.postMessage({ vibeSubmit: SUBMIT }, SITE);
  });
</script>
